summary: The Federal Supervisor Education Act requires federal government agencies to establish mandatory, comprehensive training and individual development programs for all supervisors and management officials. The Office of Personnel Management (OPM) is tasked with issuing regulations, guidance on management competencies, and overseeing agency compliance.

affected_groups.effect: Must complete mandatory initial and recurring training programs, follow individual development plans, and be assessed based on OPM management competencies.
Must establish training programs, provide developmental opportunities, assess supervisor performance, and comply with OPM regulations.
Must issue regulations, guidance on management competencies, and monitor agency compliance with the new training requirements.

key_provisions: Requires the head of each federal agency to establish comprehensive management succession and training programs in consultation with OPM.
Mandates individual development plans for supervisors covering performance goals, employee engagement, handling unacceptable performance, and addressing hostile work environments.
Requires supervisors to complete initial training within one year of appointment and repeat core training components at least once every three years.
Directs OPM to issue regulations and guidance regarding expected supervisor management competencies and agency assessment processes.
Establishes a mentoring program using experienced supervisor mentors to guide new or underperforming supervisors.
missing_information: Specific funding amounts or budgetary costs associated with implementing the training programs.
Exact details on penalties for agencies or supervisors failing to comply.
summary_detail.plain_summary: The Federal Supervisor Education Act requires federal government agencies to establish mandatory, comprehensive training and individual development programs for all supervisors and management officials. The Office of Personnel Management (OPM) is tasked with issuing regulations, guidance on management competencies, and overseeing agency compliance.
summary_detail.significance: This bill standardizes and mandates educational requirements and performance assessments for leadership personnel across the federal government, aiming to improve management practices, accountability, and employee relations.
